provenance.notes: Zone H (R5-0n.S3): the two 21x21 ring-gun frames are cells 1 and 4 of the owner-picked GYRE animation sheet (the ring turned one sixth of a turn per cell with a different muzzle flashing amber, so cell 4 sits 45 degrees from cell 1 and the lit muzzle has moved a quarter of the way round the rim), cropped from the committed winner with a 6-px key border around each subject box; the pair differs by 6.5% of their union - the ring's four-muzzle silhouette turning and the amber flash changing muzzle - and both cell aspects (0.99, 0.99) match the square slot within 1%. The sheet is clean: two rows of three real cells, no guide lines. The adaptive palette let 68 pixels of the muzzle glow's key-blended rim (≈#57dc0d) through beside the amber, so the recipe fixes the design's sixteen colours from a family census of the two cells (the navy outline, the purple-gunmetal ramp, the steel highlight, the violet shadow and the three-step amber flash). The design carries its own 1-px near-black navy outline, so the outline pass is off. The GYRE's design is the IRON CITADEL roster sheet's (manifest label zone H) though the slot serves the zone-A roster's gyre and zone G's stage decor - the zone-H lane owns the design by the pilot's label law.
